Market today: The market feels complacent with the 'fear gauge' at a low, but geopolitical risks are brewing. The big driver for your tech/chip names is Goldman Sachs' view that the Fed won't hike in September, which is generally positive for growth.

Your holdings: SOXL (-43.05%) and SPAL (-39.68%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs with significant drawdowns, and their stops are currently above their prices. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on geopolitical developments and how the market reacts to Fed expectations. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for further decay.

Bottom line: Tighten up your leveraged positions and stay sharp against market complacency.
plays: Your SOXL stop at 200 is far above its current 144.95 price. Re-evaluate this stop immediately to protect capital on this leveraged, decaying asset.
Similarly, your SPAL stop at 21.38 is above its 15.17 price. Adjust this stop now to manage risk on this new, leveraged position.
Consider a new long in LRCX, a chip name, supported by positive Fed sentiment. Scanner entry 327.99-327.67, stop 324.36.
